description: A festive holiday vignette shot at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a densely styled tabletop surface against a deep burgundy-red wall. The composition is a tight vignette centered on a collection of illuminated glass dome terrariums, each encasing small laser-cut wooden winter scenes — pine trees, a vintage green car loaded with gifts, woodland deer, and an XMAS lettering motif — all glowing with warm amber fairy-light strings. Snow-dusted white foam caps each dome, lending a wintry frosted effect. The bases are turned raw light oak rounds, grounding each piece with natural warmth. Interspersed among the domes are smaller scale decorative wooden cutout trees in natural birch finishes, a glass globe ornament with a snowman inside, and a cream pillar candle in a branded sleeve. The overall surface sits on a dark green textile runner, and dark hardcover books are partially visible beneath the arrangement, adding depth. The amber warmth radiating from the terrariums casts a soft pool of golden glow across the surrounding surface and reflects gently off the deep red wall behind. The mood is cozy, celebratory, and intimate — a holiday still life with layered textures of wood, glass, and frosted foam.
